ouse Speaker
Kevin McCarthy
(R-CA) is holding a press conference ahead of the arraignment of former President
Donald Trump
.
McCarthy is slated to begin the press conference at 2:45 p.m. EDT in Clovis, California. While it is not known what McCarthy will be speaking about exactly, he is likely to speak about the arraignment of the former president in Washington, D.C., Thursday at 4 p.m. EDT.

McCarthy previously addressed Trump’s indictment in a post on X, formerly known as Twitter, in which he accused President Joe Biden’s Department of Justice of using the indictment to distract from the House’s investigation into alleged corruption on the part of the Biden family.
